XData.name: PageContents
XData.Description: This XML block defines the contents of this pane.
XData.Data:
<pane xmlns="http://www.intersystems.com/zen" width="100%">
<hgroup valign="top" width="100%" align="left"> <!-- Create --> <vgroup valign="top" align="left" width="30%"> <fieldSet id="srcCtrlInFieldSet" legend=" Get messages " width="100%"> <form id="srcCtrlInForm" layout="vertical" cellStyle="padding: 2px; padding-left: 5px; padding-right: 5px;" width="100%">
<vgroup valign="top" width="50%" align="left"> <hgroup> <spacer width="10"/> <dataCombo id="namespace" align="left" label="Namespace" editable="false" displayColumns="1" valueColumn="1" choiceColumn="1" onchange="zenPage.ChangeNS();" queryClass="%SYS.Namespace" queryName="List" /> <spacer width="20"/> <combobox id="msgType" label="Message Type" value="HL7" > <option value="1" text="HL7" /> <option value="2" text="XML" /> <option value="3" text="X12" /> <option value="4" text=" StringContainer" /> <option value="5" text="StringRequest" /> <option value="6" text="StringResponse" /> <option value="7" text="StreamContainer GC" /> <option value="8" text="StreamContainer FC" /> <option value="9" text="StreamContainer CG" /> <option value="10" text="StreamContainer CF" /> </combobox> </hgroup> <spacer height="20"/> <hgroup width="100%"> <fieldSet id="fldSetSrcComponents" legend=" Components " width="40%" > <radioSet id="srcCompType" name="srcCompType" displayList="Service,Process,Operation" valueList="Service,Process,Operation" value="Service" align="left" onchange="zenPage.ChangeNS();" /> <spacer height="10"/> <listBox id="srcComponent" align="left" label="Names" width="100%" height="200" listHeight="200px" > <option value="1" text="Select Namespace to populate components" /> </listBox> </fieldSet> <spacer width="10"/> <fieldSet id="fldSetDestComponents" legend=" Components " width="40%" > <radioSet id="destCompType" name="destCompType" displayList="Service,Process,Operation" valueList="Service,Process,Operation" value="Process" align="left" onchange="zenPage.ChangeNS();" /> <spacer height="10"/> <listBox id="destComponent" align="left" label="Names" width="100%" height="200" listHeight="200px" > <option value="1" text="Select Namespace to populate components" /> </listBox> </fieldSet> </hgroup> </vgroup>
<spacer height="10"/> <fieldSet id="GetRecords" hidden="false" legend="Search Conditions " width="50%" align="left">
<radioSet id="srcFields" name="srcFields" displayList="Date,SessionId" valueList="Date,Session" value="Date" align="left" onclick="zenPage.changeFields();" />
<spacer height="15"/> <fieldSet id="dtRange" hidden="false" legend="Date Range " width="100%" align="left"> <hgroup valign="top" width="100%" align="left"> <calendar label="Start Date/Time (HH24:MI:SS):" id="stDtTm" name ="stDtTm" showTime="true" align="center" defaultTime="00:00:00" /> <spacer width= "10"/> <calendar label="End Date/Time (HH24:MI:SS):" id="endDtTm" name ="endDtTm" showTime="true" align="center" defaultTime="23:59:59"/> </hgroup>
</fieldSet> <fieldSet id="sessionRange" hidden="true" legend="Session Id Range " width="20%" align="left"> <hgroup valign="top" width="30%" align="left"> <text label="Start:" id="stSessionId" name="stSessionId" size="10"/> <spacer width= "10"/> <text label="End:" id="endSessionId" name="endSessionId" size="10"/> </hgroup>
</fieldSet> </fieldSet> <spacer height="20"/>
<fieldSet id="flds" legend="Addtional Fields to be written " width="20%" align="left"> <hgroup title="Include"> <checkbox caption="Session ID" id="sesId" /> <checkbox caption="Time Created" id="createTm" /> <checkbox caption="Message Body Id" id="msgBodyId" /> </hgroup> </fieldSet> <spacer height="20"/> <text label="Max number of records (optional)" id="msgCnt" name="msgCnt" size="10" onchange="zenPage.validateCnt(zenThis);"/> <spacer height="20"/> <button id="buttonGet" align="left" caption="Get Records" onclick="zenPage.getRecords();" title="Get records" /> <spacer height="25"/> <label id="lblAccess" value="" /> </form> </fieldSet> </vgroup> </hgroup> </pane>
